name: Canaccord Genuity Group Inc.
summary: Canaccord Genuity Group Inc. operates as a full-service investment dealer in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Crown Dependencies, and Australia. It operates through two segments: Canaccord Genuity Capital Markets and Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management. The Canaccord Genuity Capital Markets segment offers investment banking, advisory, research, and trading services for corporate, institutional, and government clients. Its Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management segment provides brokerage services and investment advice to retail and institutional clients.
